Paste error logs or stack traces here

## Environment

- **OS:** [e.g., Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS 14]
- **Browser:** [e.g., Chrome 124, Firefox 125]
- **Platform Version:** [e.g., v1.2.3 or commit hash]
- **Deployment:** [e.g., Docker / local dev / cloud]

### If applicable — Backend

- **Python Version:** [e.g., 3.11.9]
- **PostgreSQL Version:** [e.g., 15.6]
- **Redis Version:** [e.g., 7.2]
- **Docker Version:** [e.g., 25.0.3]

### If applicable — Frontend

- **Node Version:** [e.g., 20.12]
- **npm/pnpm Version:** [e.g., 10.5]
- **MapLibre Version:** [e.g., 4.0]

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Always reproducible
- [ ] Intermittent (describe frequency)
- [ ] Unable to reproduce (attach logs anyway)

## Data Context

- **Satellite Source:** [e.g., Landsat 9, Sentinel-2, ISRO Bhuvan]
- **Scene ID / Location:** [e.g., LC08_144048_20240315 or "Delhi, India"]
- **Processing Step:** [e.g., Upload, Spectral Indices, LST, UHI Detection, ML Prediction, Recommendations]
- **Data Size:** [e.g., 500MB GeoTIFF, 10k training samples]

## Impact

- [ ] Critical — Platform unusable, data loss, incorrect scientific output
- [ ] Major — Feature broken, no workaround
- [ ] Minor — Feature partially broken, workaround exists
- [ ] Cosmetic — UI/UX issue, no functional impact

## Possible Cause (optional)

If you have any insight into what might be causing this bug, please note it here.

## Proposed Fix (optional)

If you have a suggested fix or have already identified the solution, describe it here.

## Additional Context

Add any other context about the problem here, such as related issues, recent changes, or specific configuration details.
